title: Piercing Frame Duo #011 (얼굴 컷 · [일반·P100 정의형·얼굴만·메이크업 반바] ; [일반·P8 집중형·얼굴만·메이크업 GermanGlam])
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. TWO women side by side, each facing the camera straight on in a perfectly frontal portrait, heads level, both ears of every woman clearly visible, framed tightly from the very top of their heads down to the base of their necks and the tops of their collarbones, the frame cutting off there. Every face is large and sharp. Mid 20s.

#1: A strikingly beautiful adult Japanese woman — a deep bronze tan foundation over real skin, thick white paint bands above and below both eyes lying on the lids and never across the eyeballs, neon pink and lime paint strokes across the cheekbones, rhinestone and star stickers clustered on the cheeks and forehead only, long false lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy white lips, a fierce, playful expression, soft pastel-mint-green hair styled in high ponytail. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light.
#1 Piercings: An extreme, dense armour of about one hundred real antique-brass piercings with a few antique-brass coin drops among them covering the face: a thick antique-brass septum ring with a smaller ring above it and two antique-brass rings through each nostril; a straight antique-brass bar across the bridge of the nose between the brows; five antique-brass pieces in a row along the outer half of each eyebrow, alternating small rings that pass through the brow skin with the skin visible through each loop and small round ball studs sitting on the skin; two rows of four small antique-brass studs across the forehead above the brows; four small studs up each temple on the bone, well clear of the eyes; a row of six small studs along each cheekbone; a antique-brass Medusa stud above the lips; a big antique-brass hoop, two smaller rings and a snake-bite ring on each side through the lower lip's edge, and five small hoops along the upper lip's edge; a antique-brass labret stud and four rings through the chin; five small studs along each jaw; on each ear a full dense row of ten oversized hoops, thick bars, stretched plugs, helix rings and studs from lobe to top, the biggest hoops hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulders; and eight fine antique-brass chains looping from the ear hoops to the nostril rings and the septum ring. The piercings are packed so densely that the rows touch and overlap, leaving only hairline gaps of bare skin between them, until the face reads as a single armour of metal; the eyes and eyelids stay clear.

#2: A strikingly beautiful adult German woman — fair cool-toned skin, soft taupe eyeshadow, a glossy nude-pink lip, vivid copper-orange hair styled in a mohawk with volume along the centre of the scalp. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light.
#2 Piercings: All eight piercings gather on the left side of her face and ear, and the right side stays bare: on the left ear five pieces — a huge silver segment ring hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulder, a wide silver ear cuff, two smaller silver rings and a small silver stud at the top; two silver pieces in a row along the outer end of the left eyebrow, alternating small rings that pass through the brow skin with the skin visible through each loop and small round ball studs sitting on the skin; a small silver ring passes through the left nostril. Each piece carries small pearls set into the metal.

All piercings: All jewelry is real metal, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Pose: each woman faces the camera, arms relaxed at her sides, heads level. Generous spacing so every face reads clearly.

Lighting: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. A soft frontal light on all the faces and ears, so the makeup and the glints on every piece of metal read clearly; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 3:4 aspect ratio, 8K.
